text: Scaffolder at Moran site used broken plank from 2nd level. Plank snapped, worker fell 3m but caught himself on lower frame. Sprained wrist, monitored for 2 hours, discharged same day.

Crane at Jorhat Bypass Road lifted pump assembly. Hook block descended unexpectedly due to hydraulic leak, 500kg load dropped 2m onto concrete. Worker nearby stepped back, dust inhalation, mild bronchitis, treated with syrup.
Employee at Digboi used extension ladder without lockout tagout to reach valve. Ladder slipped on wet surface, worker fell 2m, dislocated shoulder. Reduced in ER, stable, 1 week off work.

During hoisting at Naharkatiya, tag line failed, load rotated. Flange corner grazed shoulder of crew member, abrasion and bruising. Wound cleaned and bandaged at site clinic, no further treatment needed.
Grinding flange on Digboi tank farm, ventilation poor. Operator inhaled fumes, coughing and dizziness, sent to Guwahati hospital for observation. PTW had gas test old.

Confound H2S detector alarm during tank entry at Duliajan, gas source unidentified but concentration spiked to 100ppm, entry team aborted immediately, potential asphyxiation avoided due to early detection.
Worker entered Digboi sump without valid PTW, found high level of liquid near bottom, slippery conditions with no anti-slip footwear, high risk of fall and drowning, PTW violation confirmed.

At Naharkatiya, contractor personnel entered vessel with only single LOTO applied, power isolation was incomplete for agitator drive, sudden activation possible, no lockout verification checklist completed.
Lumding Terminal tank entry attempted with venting not completed, residual hydrocarbon vapors present, static discharge hazard from clothing, ignition source not controlled.
Employee at Guwahati Depot entered manhole without buddy system, single person entry in dark area, no communication device functional, rescue capability absent.

5T crawler crane lifting spool piece at Duliajan, tag line not attached during swing. Load drifted 2m over walkway where two workers were standing. No PTW for hot work nearby but wind picked up suddenly. Near miss, no injury.

Contractor team using 25T truck crane at Moran. Rigging sling cut by sharp edge on flange during hoist. Load tilted, tag line snapped. Operator lowered slowly. SIF potential realized but no contact with ground or people. Weather clear.

Night shift Digboi, lifting pump casing across fence line. Wind gust pushed load into exclusion zone fencing. Fencing bent, load stopped 1m before office window. No shatter. LOTO in place on adjacent unit but not relevant. Near miss recorded.
During night shift at Naharkatiya, isolated section released unexpected burst of gas. SIF interlock failed to engage. No personnel exposed due to rain and distance.
Guwahati Depot storage tank gauge line had trapped pressure. Employee tightened bolt without bleeding off line. Near miss recorded, procedure violated, no injury.
Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline tie-in showed unexpected flow. Isolation valves were locked but bypass was open. Near miss, no injury, work stopped for review.
Duliajan flare cooler had residual heat and pressure. Contractor touched blind flange, causing steam release. No burn, equipment fully isolated after incident.

Night shift operator at pump station found with strong alcohol smell near SIF valve. Worker reported dizziness but no impact on equipment. Supervisor escorted off site and incident logged as near miss.
PTW holder under influence of sedatives while verifying LOTO status. Tool dropped from 4m height but missed the tank farm below. Close call recorded.
Contract staff member found with alcohol bottle in locker during morning rounds. Worker claimed it was for personal use but not consumed on site. No impairment observed during work.
Scaffold plank fractured under load at Moran, dropping 50kg wrench to ground below. Worker standing below suffered head laceration, admitted to hospital. Contractor crew, PTW valid.
Crane outrigger settled on soft ground at Naharkatiya, tipping 2-ton load onto vehicle. Driver trapped, extricated with severe crush injuries to lower limbs. Hospitalized immediately.
Vehicle reversing on lease road without spotter, struck worker knee, ankle sprain treated in field clinic.
Reversing water tanker, rear bumper clipped employee heel, laceration required stitches.
High speed on wet road during rain, vehicle hydroplaned, driver experienced whiplash, neck pain, medical observation.
Conveyor truck backing up, worker stepped back, crushed foot, toe fracture, ambulance transported to Rangia hospital.
Worker walking on lease road, pickup reversing, wheel grazed shin, deep abrasion, tetanus shot and antibiotics.
Contractor lost balance on Lumding Terminal tank roof, caught edge with hand. Slip hazard due to rain. No injury reported but potential for PSIF given unprotected edge.
Scaffold lift basket tilted slightly at Rangia, operator inside felt unstable. Hydraulic leak suspected. Work stopped immediately, no personnel below in zone.
Gas test certificate forged for confined entry at Naharkatiya, supervisor caught mismatched signature, no one entered.
Night shift operator bypassed LOTO procedure at Moran, unexpected flow from upstream caused pressure spike, no injury but system tripped.
Shackle pin on tag line slipped off unsecured load at Duliajan, striking a supervisor falling from 10ft scaffolding; he sustained a fractured wrist and was treated at RSQ.
Lifting beam overloaded at Guwahati Depot slipped off support blocks, dropping 6 inches and striking a contractor's shin as he walked underneath; swelling and bruising recorded as recordable injury.

Employee found by supervisor at 04:30 hrs near pump house smelling of alcohol. First aid administered at site clinic for dizziness but patient refused further hospital transfer. Blood sample collected and posted for lab analysis. PTW for day shift suspended pending investigation.

Contractor operator involved in minor collision with forklift during off-road transfer. Immediate first aid given for head bump and abrasions. Medical officer assessed and recommended observation. Operator reported no drug use but field officer noted suspicious behavior during pre-shift check.

Operator delayed in entering control room after smoking break. Breathalyzer showed 0.08% alcohol level. Operator visited camp infirmary due to sudden vomiting. Incident recorded as recordable due to treatment beyond first aid. Assigned duties suspended immediately.
Pickup vehicle crossed over centre line on foggy night near gate, near collision with oncoming dumper. Driver reported fatigue after 12hr shift. No injury but close call on narrow dirt road.
Cattle wandered onto access road, driver applied emergency brake causing truck to skid near embankment edge. Vehicle stopped 1m from slope. No impact but high risk of rollover.
Night shift patrol vehicle moved fast on wet tarmac, hydroplaned and drifted across lane. Nearly clipped stationary tool crate. No sign of hazard present. Driver admitted to tiredness.

Contractor scaffold gang working at 10am in Duslik. Safety belt lanyard broke under load, worker dangled for 5 mins before rescue. Required stitches on back but no fracture. PTW was valid but inspection log missing for the harness.
Forklift lifting pipe rack at 1400 hrs. Load shifted due to wet mud, struck operator's leg. Swelling and bruising, treated in canteen clinic. No sling certified, operator untrained on load trim.
Workman climbing manway fell 3m when bolt slipped. Hit knee hard on concrete pad. Pain and swelling, transported to civil hospital. No helmet, no belt. Weather windy, gusts reported.
Transporter unloading steel pipes at 2200 hrs. Chain hoist failed, pipes rolled down slope. Worker tripped and fell, twisted ankle. Lighting poor, no banking for load. Treated at site infirmary.
Operator driving company jeep on lease road at 2200 hrs hit a stray cow. Driver ran over the animal and sustained multiple fractures. Unconscious on arrival, taken to hospital via air ambulance.
Heavy rain reduced visibility on Naharkatiya access road. Forklift operator lost control while reversing near pipe rack. Machine tipped and pinned the operator's leg. Amputation below knee required.
Lorry unloading at Lumding Terminal slipped on wet surface. Trailer swung and struck the uncontrolled loading arm. Operator was 1m away when arm collapsed. Broken ribs and lacerations.
Contractor team entered Digboi sump without verifying gas test results. Sudden release of vapors caused immediate evacuation. No injuries reported but PTW violation noted.
While closing manhole cover at Naharkatiya, slip on wet surface caused worker to fall into sump. Escaped with minor bruises only. Weather was rainy and visibility low.
Contractor at Rangia found manhole open without barricade during night shift. Walked into vicinity but stepped back due to visible gas cloud. Area was isolated immediately after.
Entry into Digboi filter press vessel was initiated with incomplete gas test. High combustible gas levels detected upon entry. Immediate withdrawal performed. No ignition source present.
Morning shift crew at Duliajan blocked tank entrance with material. Worker reached in to retrieve item but pulled back when vapor cloud formed. Exposure time minimal. Wind direction changed suddenly.

Worker at Jorhat Bypass Road found intoxicated in loading bay, attempting to bypass interlock on truck coupling. Security team stopped action before plug was withdrawn without pressure check. No injury or leak, but high potential for hydraulic crush or spray burn noted.

Fuel bowser driver at Naharkatiya reported brief blackouts while driving to refueling point. Vehicle drifted near wellhead flare pit but stopped short. No fire or injury, but near miss recorded due to loss of consciousness near active ignition source.

Roofing sheet slipped from scaffold at Naharkatiya processing area. Sheet struck worker's helmet from 6m height, deflected. Worker staggered but remained stable. Hazardous zone cleared, anchor points inspected.
Contractor entered 2000 KL storage tank at Digboi without valid PTW, H2S detector alarm triggered, worker exited immediately before exposure. No injury recorded but atmospheric test was missing.
During routine inspection of sump pit at Naharkatiya, loose cover slipped, inspector stepped back avoiding fall into hydrocarbon sludge. PPE was intact, no chemical contact occurred.
Digboi storage area, contractor ladder leaned against tank inlet, foot slipped, ladder shifted but did not collapse. Worker held onto tank structure, potential for fall into tank existed.

While removing blind bolts on 6" water line, worker got high pressure spray to forearm from loose gasket. Bleeding controlled with pressure bandage, sent to camp infirmary. PTW had blind removal in scope but isolation verification was incomplete.

Contractor pinched finger between flange faces while tightening bolts on N2 line. Skin was broken and swelled up. First aid applied, treated as minor laceration requiring stitches. Shift 2 evening work.

When opening inspection blind on heavy duty separator line, high velocity fluid jet struck worker in the shoulder. Caused severe bruising and temporary loss of feeling. Medical officer prescribed rest and painkillers. No fracture found on X-ray.
While cutting bolts on corroded flange, sharp metal fragment flew off and grazed temple. Small cut caused bleeding. Cleaned and bandaged at field clinic. Worker returned to desk duties next day.
Contractor team opened manhole at Lift Station 3 without valid PTW. Gas detector reading 15% LEL but work stopped before entry. No injury, near miss only.
Expired permit found in use for hot work near flare header during night shift. Fire watch absent. H2S alarm triggered, crew withdrew immediately. No damage or injury.
Drilling rig crew used general permit for specific wellhead operation. PTW not specific to high-risk activity. Sudden pressure spike contained by BOP. No injury or spill, near miss.
Operator under influence found sleeping on pump platform at Duliajan, woke up confused and developed severe nausea requiring ambulance transfer to hospital.
Driver at Naharkatiya reported positive drug test after minor collision with bollards, sustained minor lacerations on hand treated by site medic.
Technician at Moran found slumped over control panel during night shift, exhibited slurred speech indicative of alcohol impairment, taken for medical evaluation.
Contractor at Jorhot Bypass Road observed handling valves while visibly impaired by alcohol, slip resulted in head bump and severe headache requiring hospital checkup.
Morning shift supervisor at Duliajan failed pre-start sobriety test, showed signs of hangover and disorientation, taken to clinic for monitoring of blood pressure.
Contractor welding on 6in pipeline at Digboi without hot work PTW. Sparks hit nearby leaking valve, small fire started, hand burn to worker requiring dressing.
Guwahati Depot night shift. Grinding near diesel pump. Slip on oil spill while moving grinder, worker fell and fractured wrist. Ambulance dispatched, hospitalised for cast application.
Duliajan terminal. Hot work on flange bolt. Hydraulic leak under pressure caused scalding injury to leg. Skin peeled, treated with sterile dressings, recorded as severity 2 injury.
While cutting flange bolts on line 301, residual pressure caused steam jet injury to hand. Employee received first aid and referred to site hospital for treatment.
Contractor failed to isolate hydraulic accumulator before removing cover. Residual pressure ejected pin causing laceration to forearm. Medical attention required on site.
During maintenance of compressor, trapped spring energy released upon disassembly. Employee sustained abrasions to leg from falling valve plate. Treated at clinic.
Unisolated static electricity discharge from drum during pumping operation. Spark caused minor burn to operator's palm. No further injury reported.
Residual gas pressure in pipeline section caused valve handle to spin violently. Employee struck face by handle, nosebleed and soft tissue injury. Ambulance called for assessment.

LOTO tag removed prematurely by another crew while capacitor bank de-energizing. Stored charge caused electric shock to worker, muscle cramps and dizziness. Admitted to local hospital for observation.
Spring-loaded safety valve lifted unexpectedly during test, scalding steam contacted face. Minor blistering and eye irritation reported. Medical check-up completed on site.

Welding on pig launcher at Duliajan without proper LOTO, pressure leak caused face shield to blow off hitting eye causing corneal abrasion. PTW was valid but isolation points were not tagged correctly.

During night shift cleanout at Lumding Terminal, an employee slipped on oily sludge inside the tank and fractured a finger on the manhole rim. Supervisor applied first aid but worker insist on X-ray at local clinic.
At Naharkatiya, a labourer got a severe laceration from a corroded steel flange edge while crawling into the vessel. Bleeding stopped with pressure bandage but required stitches at camp infirmary.
While removing a blind flange at Naharkatiya, a sharp edge grazed the worker's calf. Minor hydrocarbon splash also noted. Received antibiotic prophylaxis and dressing change at medical bay.

Scaffold platform at Moran P&G shook violently during material hoist. TBT not tightened on base supports before lift. Platform tilted 15 degrees, workers on top held on. 200kg load suspended 3m above. No fall occurred but imminent risk of collapse onto workers below.

Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline trench, scaffolding tower leaned over edge. Wind gust during monsoon season caused tower to shift 30cm. Worker on level 2 clutching guardrail. Load of pipes stored on ground level below tower. If tower fell, pipes would have collapsed onto workers. No injury but critical instability.
Temporary scaffold leg buckled under load, platform tilted 45 degrees, worker inside LOTO zone, no fall due to tight space, no injury, PTW renewed yesterday.
Night shift, lighting poor on Rangia pipeline corridor, worker tripped on uneven ground near valve, fell 1 meter, no impact, no injury, visibility issue noted.
Naharkatiya tank roof inspection, guardrail gate left open, inspector stepped back, almost fell, caught by supervisor, no injury, PTW expired, work stopped.
Contractor found working on pump seal without valid PTW, gas test paper expired 2 hrs prior. Spilled lubricant caused slip, cut on forearm required sutures.
Expired hot work permit used for welding on pipeline. Minor flash burn on hand, treated by site medic. No fire escalation.

Cow wandered onto Jorhat Bypass road near site entry, patrol jeep braked hard, passenger slumped forward hitting dashboard. Passenger required medical check for chest pain, no fracture but significant bruising. No PTW needed for road patrol, but speed limit was exceeded.
Employee slipped on wet surface inside empty storage tank and fractured left wrist during climb down ladder, PTW was valid but grounding strip not installed properly.
Bystander near manhole sustained minor laceration on hand when worker dropped entry inspection tool, injury treated with first aid only but logged as recordable due to broken skin depth.
Contractor inhaling residual vapors inside sump leading to eye irritation and vomiting, removed from confined space immediately and treated at field medical unit.
During pipe run at Digboi, load swing due to high wind caused near miss with derrick leg, tag line held but no contact.
Naharkatiya: Sling failed on flyaway load at dusk, debris landed 2 meters from worker, no injury reported, PTW valid.
Rangia: Overturned wellhead tong during lift, load dropped 3 ft from trestle, no one in suspended load zone, near miss.
Duliajan: Wire rope parting on 5-ton load, load swung into wind direction away from crew, no contact, rig up delayed.
Scaffold board snapped under foot during rain at night, worker fell 3m onto pipe rack, dislocated shoulder needing reduction at hospital.
Employee kicked loose bolt while standing on platform edge, lost footing, fell 1.5m onto concrete, head contusion and neck strain.
Worker climbed on outside of scaffold frame without authorization, slipped on muddy ground below, fractured fibula after fall.
Employee failed to tie off to anchor point while cleaning platform, slipped on oil spill, fell 3m, severe bruising to hip and back.
No gas test done before entering pump house. Worker ignited atmosphere with grinder, flash fire singed eyebrows and face. First aid insufficient, medic took over.
Contractor bypassed permit requirement for electrical work. Arc flash occurred, minor burns to forearms. Skin peeled, infection risk high. Medical treatment started.
Cutting on storage tank roof, grinder slipped into tank. Tank was not fully degassed and purged. Spark ignited vapours. Worker fell but caught on edge. Potential fatality if tank blew.
Welding on active pipeline, H2S alarm triggered. Worker exposed to high concentration. Unplanned release could have caused asphyxiation or poisoning. Evacuation delayed due to communication gap.
Cutting on tank bottom, water hammer effect caused structural failure. Tank collapsed partially. Worker was 2 meters away. Debris shower and potential crush injury avoided only by chance.
During night shift operations, a shackle pin dislodged from the hook block, and the load of 500kg valves fell onto the hardstand; near miss as area was cordoned off.
Load suspended over the truck bed shifted suddenly, nearly pinning the tailgate operator against the vehicle structure before being secured.
Residual pressure in 150m pipeline released upon valve opening during LOTO bypass. Worker stood downwind, high velocity spray izzu but no contact. Pressure gauge was faulty.

Expander compressor unisolated, rotating assembly spun down slowly but stored rotational energy remained. Tool contact caused kickback, tool struck shoulder area narrowly avoided. No mechanical guard removed.
Gas spring in manway cover released upon disengagement. High velocity upward force, cover bounced 2m, worker below missed by 1 foot. No isolation verification done.

During maintenance of vapor recovery unit at Guwahati Depot, confined space entry without proper gas monitoring, sudden release of H2S caused two workers to collapse, rescue team extracted them but one succumbed to asphyxiation despite CPR, fatal incident.

Welding on underground pipeline excavation at Rangia field, shoring collapsed due to heavy machinery vibration, worker pinned under steel casing, hip fracture sustained, evacuated by air ambulance, serious injury confirmed.

Hot work permit expired before completion of weld on steam line at Duliajan, contractor continued operation, steam blowout occurred striking supervisor, second degree burns to upper body, admitted to district hospital, recordable case.
Welding spark near 6 inch line caused rapid H2S bleed into pit. Wind shifted suddenly, detector alarm tripped before concentration reached LEL. No one inhaled due to immediate evacuation order.
Grinding off old coupling on storage tank nozzle created heavy dust. Sudden wind gust blew debris into filter housing, causing clog. No fire or ignition occurred.
Cutting wheel broke during operation, fragment flew towards worker's face. Hard hat visor deflected shard. Worker flinched back, no contact with skin. Tool locked out immediately.
Worker slipped on slick mud while prying open a flange on the 4-inch letdown line during rain. He fell and twisted his ankle, requiring splinting and transport to nearest clinic.
H2S alarm triggered when gasket failed on inspection side during blind removal. Worker inhaled low level H2S, felt giddiness, given oxygen and case medically recorded.

PTW issued for valve maintenance but upstream pressure not bled off. Erection crew failed LOTO check, pipeline residual pressure released causing Ghee to suffer laceration to forearm. First aid applied on site, later transferred to hospital for stitching. Contractor worker from Digboi shift.

High pressure hose replacement, fluid spray from unisolated fitting. Hydraulic oil jet caused laceration to palm. First aid failed to stop bleeding, emergency transport to hospital. Employee from Digboi production wing.

Valve stem repair, downstream pressure not vented. Residual energy in pipe section forced plug out. Worker face scratched by metal fragments, eye injury suspected. Ophthalmologist consult arranged. Contractor from Duliajan gas plant.

During PTW verification at Digboi, contractor found blind flange loose on 6 inch line. Slight H2S whiff detected, no exposure as area was evacuated immediately. No injury, potential for significant release.

Morning shift at Lumding Terminal, valve stem sheared off during maintenance. High pressure gas hissed but no one was standing in the direct path due to proper barricading. No casualties, event recorded as near miss.
In rainy conditions at Rangia, blind blind fell during removal from 2 inch line. Dropped on pipe rack, no personnel underneath. Good visibility despite rain, no injury, near miss only.
Employee double-checking isolation at Duliajan heard pop from gasket. Small leak, no fire. Worker used detector, confirmed low levels. No exposure, no injury, near miss situation.
At Digboi, blind stayed in but line depressurized unexpectedly. Hissing sound audible, but no flash fire. PPE was intact. No burn or injury, recorded as near miss.
Morning inspection at Naharkatiya found loose pinch bolt on blind. Gentle leak of hydrocarbon. Area was empty during detection. No injury, potential release prevented, near miss.
While lifting 200kg pipe bundle at Duliajan, tag line snapped due to weak knot causing load swing. Operator's hand crushed between sling and pipe edge, required stitching at on-site clinic.
During night shift at Moran, load of valves dropped from 2m height due to slipped eyebolt. Debris struck worker's torso and ribs, treating for multiple bruised ribs and soft tissue injury.
At Jorhat Bypass Road, mobile crane outrigger sunk into soft ground during lift operation. Load shifted abruptly, crushing operator's heel against cab frame, severe contusion and toe injury treated.
Duliajan night shift saw a hoist brake failure mid-air. Load swung into a support structure, ricocheting a metal sheet that cut through PPE, creating deep gash on thigh requiring 12 stitches.
Crane slewed unexpectedly due to control fault, hook load passed inches from worker climbing derrick ladder, worker held fast but load path intersected body, no injury recorded.

Lifting sling snagged on pipe rack corner causing violent jerk, pipe bundle tipped towards gas compartment, worker dodged at last second, H2S alarm not yet triggered but potential fatigue release high.
Hoist chain kinked and slipped from hook mid-lift, heavy valve body dropped on operator toe, minimal bruising but drop height and mass posed lethal crush risk.

Swing hook disengaged from sling during boom retraction, hook struck head of signalman working below, helmet absorbed impact but skull fracture potential high, worker shaken but refusal for treatment.
During PTW verification, main blind valve position not confirmed before opening flange. Slight H2S leak detected by portable detector, area secured immediately no one in zone. Shift A

Opening of 4-inch feed line at Naharkatiya battery limits. Frangible gasket sheared, high pressure spray directed away from control room. Alarm triggered, LOTO applied. No personnel in immediate spray path
Night shift routine inspection at Moran separator area. Loose packing on bleed valve caused jet stream for seconds. Operator retreated safely, TBT documented. No exposure. Rainy weather

Guwahati Depot maintenance crew unblinding 6-inch UOP line. Blind flew off due to forgotten bolt torque check. Discharge hit adjacent wall, no worker close enough to be struck. Alarm sounded, area isolated

Rangia refinery inlet valve operation. Gasket blowout created sonic boom and vapor cloud. Crowd evacuation drill initiated, no injuries reported. Wind direction favorable, plume dispersed quickly. Daytime

Naharkatiya dehydration unit. Pressure equalization line spade removal caused misting. Guardrail missing on platform, but worker stood behind barrier. No fall, no splash contact. Recorded as near miss
Scaffold steel base plate slid on wet surface during assembly, causing 20cm drop of upper frame. No fall of workers. Weather condition ignored in risk assessment.
Hand tool bag dropped from platform edge by contractor, bounced off steel beam and fell 10m. No personnel below but exclusion zone not maintained. PTW violation cited.
Mastiff vehicle speeding on Lumding Terminal approach, hit patch of mud and skidded towards fire truck bay. Brake applied late, no collision, fatigue suspected driver was on 4th shift.
Bulldozer reversing near Naharkatiya fence line, operator vision blocked by tree, nearly struck cycle track. Worker walking there shouted, dozer stopped. Spotter not assigned as per plan.
Heavy crate truck reversing at Rangia gate, alarm not audiable due to generator noise. Forklift operator stopped inches from reversing truck. LOTO not checked, PTW expired by 10 min.
Jeep on Moran lease road, hit pothole at high speed, jumped up and hit low hanging branch. Glass cracked but no breakage, driver uninjured. Rain slicked surface contributed.
Agri-pump vehicle reversing on Digboi internal road, rear view mirror obstructed by rain. Hit curb, no person in path. Driver fresh on duty but visibility poor due to monsoon.
Operator reversing K6 truck on lease road near Duliajan, low visibility due to mist, pedestrian was 2 meters away but jumped aside. PTW valid but spotter was not in position, near miss recorded.
Contractor 4x4 speeding past Digboi site gate, tire blew out causing vehicle to swerve towards water separator. No contact with assets or personnel, immediate stop and control restored.

Manhole cover opened at Lumding Terminal during shift change, maintenance vehicle almost ran over utility worker. Worker stepped back just in time, no injury but high potential for crush injury noted.
Fuel tanker unloading at Guwahati Depot, fire extinguisher cart fell from hitch. Rolled 10 feet towards driver who was stepping out of cab. Driver jumped back, no injury, cart damaged.
Technician found 5 psi residual pressure in trap during tagging check after LOTO. No PTW violation but alarm raised immediately. Near miss logged.
Residual hydrocarbon mist escaped from drain valve after LOTO verification. Smell detected by nearby operator. Venting protocol missed during handover.
Stored energy in compressed gas header discharged on opening blind. Deafening noise and pressure wave. No injury but safety stand-down called.
Driver of fuel tanker admitted to consuming sedatives before dawn patrol. Vehicle drift onto pedestrian walkway near loading arm, near-miss collision with active crew, no brake failure confirmed.

Maintenance technician found with uncapped chemical drum nearby, suspecting substance use due to nodding off at control panel. Potential exposure to H2S if alarm silence ignored due to impairment, confined space entry attempted without proper PPE.

Contractor refused breathalyzer at Rangia transfer station, citing personal reasons. Later found sleeping in electrical room with active SIF bypassed, high risk of electrocution or arc flash if equipment faulted during sleep.
Plasma cutter tip touched live conductor near pump, arc flash scare but LOTO verified and no burn injury to operator.
Crane hook swinging close to operator during load swing at 10 AM, cleared by spotter in time.
Suspension scaffold drifted off anchor point during high wind, corrected immediately by team.
Lifting lug cracked during pre-lift inspection, load grounded, tooling replaced before start.
Worker used rope as part of lift sling, inspected and found flaw, removed from service.
H2S alarm triggered during hot work near suspended tank, personnel evacuated, no exposure.
Contractor climbed 4.5m platform without harness while coating pipe, slipped and landed on lower tray, right ankle sprained severely, sent to field clinic, no PTW valid for height work.
Rooftop AC unit maintenance in progress, ladder rung broke under load, worker fell 2m onto gravel, cut on left palm requiring sutures, LOTO done but edge protection missing.
Working on 2m high railing for painting, lean-back caused loss of balance, worker dropped 1.5m, soft tissue injury to knee, required physiotherapy, no permit for confined/height overlap.
Ladder extended too high onto maintenance gantry, top rung slipped off edge, worker on 3rd rung fell 2m, fractured forearm, hospital transferred, ladder not secured at top.
Scaffold tower unbalanced during assembly, worker on 2nd level stepped onto loose tie, fell 1.8m, abrasions and minor concussion, checked in clinic, no sign-off for stability check.
